text:
Alex W: quick sync — opened a PR to simplify the audit log examples and add a retention matrix section. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432. tagging legal + eng for sign-off.
Maria G: saw it, thanks. main asks: (1) simplify the sample rows, (2) add an explicit TTL example per tenant, (3) include a short SDK curl + ruby snippet.
Tom R: looks OK at a glance. one thing: the curl example uses the old /v1/audit-log export param. should be /v2/export now. i'll patch if you want.
Alex W: yes please patch, and also can you add the small code comment about pseudonymization being an opt-in on export? legal asked for the wording.
Sara L (Legal): suggested phrasing: "Exports omit tenant PII by default; customers can request tenant-level pseudonymization via the export API flag. See retention table for TTL defaults." okay to use that wording? 
Maria G: that phrasing works, maybe shorten to: "By default, exports hide tenant PII. Use the pseudonymize=true export flag to include masked identifiers." thoughts?
Sara L (Legal): that shorter phrasing is fine as long as we link to the export flag docs. add a link to the API reference on the same section.
Tom R: pushed a tiny change — bumped export endpoint to /v2/export and updated the flag name to pseudonymize=true. also added this snippet: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v2/export" "-H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'" "-d '{"tenant_id":"t_123","pseudonymize":true,"retention_days":90}'"```
Alex W: nice. can we also include a Ruby SDK sample? lightweight: ```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'])
export = client.audit_logs.export(tenant_id: 't_123', pseudonymize: true, retention_days: 90)
puts export.job_id
```
Maria G: perfect. i'll add both snippets into the PR and update the retention table to show three columns: data type, default TTL, recommended override.
Tom R: heads-up — we need to call out privileged-role access for export endpoints in the same section (SRE requested). one sentence should be enough.
Sara L (Legal): agree, add: "Export requests require role=auditor or role=admin and are logged in the audit trail." makes it audit-friendly for SOC2.
docs-bot: PR 432 status: changes requested by @Tom R; reviewers: @Maria G, @Sara L (Legal). CI: docs-build passed.
Alex W: ok team, action items: Maria will fold wording + snippets into PR, Tom will sanity-check endpoints and perms, Sara will do final legal phrasing review. aiming to merge by EOD Thursday.
Maria G: on it. i'll also add a small migration note for SDK consumers: "If you previously called /v1/audit/export, switch to client.audit_logs.export and the pseudonymize flag name has changed from mask_pii -> pseudonymize."
Tom R: one tiny nit — internal telemetry field names changed (export_job_id -> job_id). i'll add a line in the migration note so customers mapping logs won't break.
Sara L (Legal): LGTM on schedule. i'll review final PR before merge.
Alex W: thanks all :thumbsup: if anything blocks, drop it here and i'll escalate.
docs-bot: link-checker: verified all internal anchors referenced in the new section.
Maria G: pushing the update now. 
Alex W: merging after legal thumbs.
Sara L (Legal): approved in the PR comments, minor punctuation fix.
Alex W: merged. thanks everyone! :tada:
